title: FlyNYON Helicopter Tours
specs: Doors-off flights provide unobstructed views for aerial photography
Sunset flights offer golden hour lighting and city lights views
Passengers over 310 lbs inclusive of gear must purchase a second seat
Maximum single passenger weight limit 350 lbs inclusive of gear
Children under 2 may fly as lap child on doors-off flights; 2 years and older must purchase seat
Parent or guardian must sign consent form if under 18
Gimbals over 10 lbs subject to pilot approval
Private flights available for groups of 4 to 6 passengers
includes: Flight suit and safety harness for doors-off flights
Flight with experienced pilots and maintained jet-engine helicopters
GoPro mounts available for doors-off flights
gap: Exact minimum age for solo passengers not stated
blurb: FlyNYON provides helicopter flights from Kearny, NJ, with options for doors-off and doors-on experiences. Flights range from 15 to 37 minutes, covering iconic NYC landmarks with customizable routes for photography. The company emphasizes safety, professional pilots, and a unique aerial photography experience.
extraNote: All purchases are nonrefundable · Flight vouchers valid for 12 months · Cancellations by FlyNYON due to weather result in flight voucher refund less insurance cost · No shows or cancellations within 48 hours forfeit full price · Late arrival fee $75 per person if arriving less than 75 minutes before departure · FlyNYON may cancel or reschedule flights due to weather, ATC delays, or other uncontrollable events · Dynamic or surge pricing applies during high demand times · FlyNYON Terminal in Kearny, NJ

quotes.text: Great experience ! we were on stand-by mode because of the wind but that was totally understandable for safety :) and we ended up going as soon as it was safe to do so! shout out to our pilot Daran who was very professional and kind ! he managed to make a smooth flight, even with the wind! and he was very nice before, during and after the flight. make sure to come 1h15 ahead of time, and to have your photo ID. also have your order number, they will ask for it :)

We had an amazing experience with FlyNyon! Melissa helped us when we first arrived, and helped us upgrade to a longer flight. The flight itself was unreal, being able to have your feet outside the helicopter is a surreal experience, but made for some brilliant photos. The safety procedures were really thorough and we were made to feel really safe throughout. I would definitely recommend FlyNyon to anyone looking for a really unique experience in NYC!

We had the incredible pleasure of flying with FlyNYON Helicopter Tours and it was an experience we will never forget! We opted for the flight with open doors, which made the view and feeling even more intense. It's absolutely worth every penny. The whole experience was professional, safe and simply breathtaking. A true once-in-a-lifetime adventure that we would definitely book again! Many thanks to the FlyNYON team for this unforgettable experience!

My boyfriend surprised me with a FlyNYON helicopter ride for my birthday, and it was unforgettable! We originally booked the 15-minute ride but got a discount to upgrade to the 30-minute doors-off flight, and it was so worth it. Seeing all of NYC from above was breathtaking, and the pilot was incredible. I even got to sit shotgun, which made the experience even more special. Highly recommend for an unforgettable adventure!

Great overall experience and service! Due to weather conditions, my flight needed to be rescheduled, but the FlyNYON team always reached out to me in a timely manner. The team that helped us put on the harnesses and driving us to the takeoff zone was great. Darren, our pilot, was very professional. Christina at the counter was awesome as she helped me get my Uber back home. I will soon be back for sure!

My husband and I LOVED this experience! 100% recommended. Team was excellent, will be coming back! FYI-please be aware, they normally assign seats based on weight and the type of ticket you purchased! They have a shoe selfie warranty, you can either get a seat next to a door or on the other side that doesn’t have a door, BOTH seats are “Shoe Selfie” seats
